title: Julia Roberts, Paul Rudd and Steve Carell Lead Broadway's Starry 2027
excerpt:
Broadway's winter and spring season brings major screen actors to the stage.
New productions feature Julia Roberts, Sarah Paulson, Steve Carell and others.
body_md:
Broadway is preparing a particularly star-filled stretch of productions in early 2027, with familiar film and television performers appearing in new stagings and revivals. The lineup is designed to attract both regular theatergoers and audiences who know the actors primarily from their screen work.

Small Mouth Sounds will feature Julia Roberts, Paul Rudd and Sarah Paulson alongside Martin Freeman and Greta Lee. Directed by Joe Mantello, the production begins previews on February 10, 2027, before its official opening on March 11.

Steve Carell and John C. Reilly will headline The Odd Couple as Felix Ungar and Oscar Madison. Performances are scheduled to begin March 3, with opening night set for March 23. Other notable productions include Three Days of Rain with David Corenswet and Yvonne Strahovski, The Amish Project with Jonathan Groff, and Evita starring Rachel Zegler.

These dates refer to live theatrical performances in New York, not cinema releases or streaming premieres. The concentration of recognizable names could help sustain ticket demand after the holiday season.
